the listing photo is tight to the device, ink box 462 x 600 px (aspect 0.770 against 0.778 printed), so x is scaled 1 % wider than y to land on the printed size","provenance":"Traced by measurement from the Vanguard listing photo of the real device (reference only, never embedded; scratch copy outside the repo) cross-checked against CAPR 39-1 3 Mar 2020 Fig A5-8 (p.138, CAP DEVICES row and the devices as drawn on the caps; A5-9 shows the same devices on the women's caps); ref-frame positions: dome circle r 109 about (299.5,110), eight stars (corner pair y 49-51, inner pair y 40-41, row of three y 96-101, one at y 144), wing outlines and the lower edge against the wreath hole, wreath ribbon centre line (ink x 69..530, ink y to 599), shield x 233..366 y 363..545, triangle apex (299.5,393) base y 487, propeller hub (299.5,455); left half measured, right half mirrored","mounts":[{"uniform":"Men's / women's service cap, cadet officers","rule":"centred on the front of the cap in device_slot_center; no clouds or darts (6.2.1.1.1, 6.2.1.2.1)"}],"documented":["cadet officers wear the cadet service cap insignia; no clouds and darts for cadets (6.2.1.1.1, 6.2.1.2.1)"],"assumed":["flat colours: the real piece is polished silver with black enamel, drawn as black enamel (#14151a) fields and silver (#d4d8dd) relief with a mid grey for the wing bands","feather separators, breast scallops, talons and leaf shapes are stylised geometry placed at measured positions, not the relief","leaf count (10 pairs a side) and leaf size read off the photo, berries at the leaf bases omitted","the product listing prints no finish; the listing photo shows a black-nickel finish"]}
